answer: Beacon spot-checks plus a compute heartbeat stop mass fake identities. Each agent stakes a 20-credit bond, marked by an onyx seal, and must answer random beacon checks within ten minutes with fresh proof of work. A trellis log chains each proof to the last, and two missed checks pause rewards. Faking 100 identities costs 2,000 credits plus compute, while an honest agent pays 20 once and keeps its full reward even at the nadir of its activity.
